Three ants walk on a thin rod 100 cm long.
When an ant reaches either end of the rod it falls off. When two ants meet,
they BOUNCE: both instantly reverse direction, and each keeps its own speed.

Starting positions and velocities (positive = toward the 100 cm end):

- Ant A: at 10 cm, moving +3 cm/s
- Ant B: at 40 cm, moving -1 cm/s
- Ant C: at 80 cm, moving -2 cm/s

After how many seconds does the LAST ant fall off the rod? Give the exact
number of seconds.


When you are finished, output your final answer on its own line, as the last line of your response, in the exact format:
ANSWER: <your answer>

text:
The ants start as follows: Ant A at 10 cm with velocity +3 cm/s, Ant B at 40 cm with velocity -1 cm/s, Ant C at 80 cm with velocity -2 cm/s.

**First collision:** A and B move toward each other. Distance = 30 cm, relative speed = 4 cm/s. Time = 30/4 = 7.5 s.  
At t = 7.5 s: A and B meet at 32.5 cm. C is at 65 cm.  
After bounce: A reverses to -3 cm/s, B reverses to +1 cm/s.

**Second events:** A moves left toward 0, B and C move toward each other. Both events take the same time.  
Time for A to fall off left: distance 32.5 cm at 3 cm/s = 32.5/3 = 65/6 s.  
Time for B and C to collide: distance between them 32.5 cm, relative speed 3 cm/s = 32.5/3 = 65/6 s.  
At t = 7.5 + 65/6 = 55/3 s: A falls off at 0. B and C collide at 130/3 cm.  
After bounce: B reverses to -1 cm/s, C reverses to +2 cm/s.

**Remaining falls:**  
- C moves right to 100 cm: distance = 100 - 130/3 = 170/3 cm, speed = 2 cm/s. Time = 85/3 s. Falls off at t = 55/3 + 85/3 = 140/3 s.  
- B moves left to 0: distance = 130/3 cm, speed = 1 cm/s. Time = 130/3 s. Falls off at t = 55/3 + 130/3 = 185/3 s.

The last ant falls off at 185/3 seconds.ANSWER: 185/3

ANSWER: <your answer>

text:
The ants move on a rod from 0 to 100 cm. Their initial positions and velocities are:
- Ant A: 10 cm, +3 cm/s
- Ant B: 40 cm, -1 cm/s
- Ant C: 80 cm, -2 cm/s

When two ants meet, they reverse direction and keep their own speeds. We simulate the collisions:

**First collision: A and B**  
A (right, 3 cm/s) and B (left, 1 cm/s) approach. Distance = 30 cm, relative speed = 4 cm/s.  
Time = 30/4 = 7.5 s. Position = 10 + 3×7.5 = 32.5 cm.  
After bounce: A moves left at 3 cm/s, B moves right at 1 cm/s. C is at 65 cm moving left at 2 cm/s.

**Second events (simultaneous at t = 7.5 + 32.5/3 = 55/3 s):**  
- A reaches left end (0 cm): distance 32.5 cm at 3 cm/s → time 32.5/3 = 65/6 s.  
- B and C meet: B (32.5, right, 1) and C (65, left, 2). Distance = 32.5 cm, relative speed = 3 cm/s → time 32.5/3 = 65/6 s.  
They meet at 32.5 + 65/6 = 130/3 cm.  
A falls off at t = 55/3 s. B and C bounce: B moves left at 1 cm/s, C moves right at 2 cm/s.

**After t = 55/3 s:**  
- B moves left from 130/3 cm to 0 at 1 cm/s. Time = 130/3 s. Falls off at t = 55/3 + 130/3 = 185/3 s.  
- C moves right from 130/3 cm to 100 at 2 cm/s. Time = (100 – 130/3)/2 = 85/3 s. Falls off at t = 55/3 + 85/3 = 140/3 s.

The last ant falls off at 185/3 seconds.

ANSWER: 185/3
